$note: The product's CATEGORICAL chart series palette (Highcharts) — the ordered hues assigned to series 1..N in a multi-series chart. Source of truth: src/utils/chart-colors.js (getChartColors → colors / colorsDark). This is NOT the brand palette: charts use these distinguishable categorical hues, NOT --primary navy. Severity/status colours in charts still come from the severity tokens (variables.json). Consume in order; wrap after the last. Theme-aware: use the light array under :root, the dark array under the dark theme.
$rules: Categorical only: assign hues to series by ORDER (series 1 → series[0], series 2 → series[1], …). Don't hand-pick.
A single-series trend needs no palette — use one --primary-alt or a severity colour if it encodes status.
Severity/threshold charts (gauge zones, availability, alert bands) use the severity tokens, NOT this categorical palette.
Never recolour a chart with the brand navy --primary — series must stay visually distinguishable.
